overloads.semanticRole: INTERSECTION compares set1 and set2 and selects only the records that are in both.

constraints: set1 and set2 must belong to the same table; resultSet is created on that same table.
resultSet replaces any existing set of the same name, including the case where resultSet has the same name as set1 or set2.
resultSet retains a current record only if the same record was the current record in both set1 and set2; otherwise it has no current record.
In Client/Server, all three sets must be visible on the same machine (visibility depends on set type -- interprocess/process/local -- and where each was created).
